target_customer: Architects, engineers and general contractors reviewing 2D PDF plan sets
problem: Drawing sets contain coordination conflicts and omissions that cause rework and RFIs.

founders.name: Milind Sagaram
founders.role: CTO (YC page); a March 2026 podcast listing calls him CEO
founders.background_notes: Team size 2 per YC; only one founder named.

competitors.name: InspectMind AI
competitors.what: AI checker agent for construction drawings, YC launch

competitors.name: Flikt.AI
competitors.what: Conflict review of 2D PDF sets, $4 per page after 200

technical_complexity.rationale: Vision and LLM analysis of multi-discipline drawings with page-level coordinates; accuracy is the hard part and not independently validated.

defensibility.rationale: Several similar tools exist; integrations with Procore and Autodesk are the main stickiness.

market_need_then: Rework cost is a known construction pain; the site claims $500M+ rework avoided, unverified.

brand_strength.rationale: Renamed from Articulate per sources, but no press on the new brand and no explanation found.

outcome_analysis: Helonic is a two person Fall 2025 company that analyzes construction PDFs for clashes and drafts RFIs. It was previously called Articulate. Funding is unconfirmed and no exit news exists. Success will hinge on accuracy and distribution into contractors against several similar AI drawing review tools.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom lists a $125k seed with no investors; single aggregator. Founding year conflicts (BuiltWorlds 2019, YC 2025). Location listed as NYC on YC page and San Francisco elsewhere. Rebrand date unknown.
